This is a great massage tool, which fits perfectly into my hand and glides on smooth on my cheeks, forehead, chin and even lips. This really does slim my face. It also helps increase blood circulation so new skin cells can grow and keep my skin glowing.  I recommend this product!

Perhaps the stimulation is releasing collagen build up as well because, to me at least, my face has taken on a bit of a glow and looks healthier. I slather on moisturizer and massage it into my face and neck using the scraper tool before going to bed and occasionally use it before applying make-up in the morning. reviews.t: I didn't believe the hype, but I do now ...
reviews.x: I didn't believe the hype, but I do now. After using this a week every night (with coconut oil) my dark circles under my eyes are much less dark and my skin seems to be clearing up. I put it in the freezer with my jade rollers and use them every night before bed.

reviews.x: This little massager is curved perfectly to fit facial planes, leaving red splotchy trails that disappear completely by morning, as they should.  When used on a regular basis, my round face seems somewhat more shapely, almost sleek.

reviews.t: Perfect size and it really is jade.
reviews.x: It's the perfect size and shape for face massages, came in perfect condition and the color is a lot lovelier than expected. It really is jade and is cool to the touch. The packaging is a small ziplock type bag. I would wash it before and after use. It's also helpful to run it under icy water or put it in the freezer first. Plus it's the perfect shape to rest underneath your eyes to cool them and reduce dark circles. Overall, I'm very pleased.

reviews.t: Very small. I had another one that dropped and ...
reviews.x: Very small.  I had another one that dropped and broke.  It was about 6-7 inches long in the longest dimension.  This one is about 4 inches or less long.  It is almost impossible for my hands to use well.

reviews.t: Amazing!
reviews.x: Amazing! I couldn't be happier with this! First time I ever tried gua sha and I am impressed! As long as you dont mind the bruising! The size is a little small and can be uncomfortable to use for long periods but this one is shaped perfectly for the face and neck area. I'm sure I'll be buying more to keep every where I go or work!

reviews.t: Does the job perfect and its cheap
reviews.x: I honestly cant tell if this is actually jade or not, but whatever it is it is not plastic or glass and it is dense, heavy, and smooth, perfect for facial massage. I use this while Im using a cleanser because it helps the tool slide along your skin without pulling. I also use this: [...] facial massage routine (skip to 8:36 because this is when the actual tutorial starts) and what I've found is that over the few weeks I've been consistently doing this, my face has slimmed down. I am impressed.

reviews.t: Awesome
reviews.x: I was very skeptical!  Change face? Look younger?  pfft...not this little piece of jade!  Well, I was wrong.  After just a few days, I could tell a difference, the bags under my eyes are almost gone, and I  have lost a little of my side jowls.  No, I  do not expect miracles but this is pretty cool.  The fact that it is also "natural"  is an absolute plus along with the stone giving a cool feeling against my skin.

reviews.t: Work out the knots in your forearms
reviews.x: These little jade stones work very well for working out knots in small areas.  In particular I find most people have lots of trigger points in their forearms.  This works great for self treatment.  I usually use it with a little bit of analgesic lotion. These aren't as rough as more traditional guasha tools. It's hard to induce bruising but works well and is more to Western taste in that regard.

reviews.t: Great for those nights you want to treat yourself with a little beauty regime.
reviews.x: Not sure if it was a placebo, but after a night of vigorously massaging my face with this and some moisturizer, the next morning my skin appeared so dewy and healthy! Just youtube the directions to massage, because i was just going all over the place with this in the beginning, but these is specific directions to stroke your face with to see positive effects.

reviews.t: Fast results
reviews.x: You can see results as early as the next day. I apply vit E oil all over my face then I use this to massage my face and neck for about 5 minutes. I have only used it 3 times and my lines definitely are not as deep. My eye bags are gone and my skin color looks even and brighter. I love this product so much that I ordered another one for my mom.

claims.text: Many reviewers say the tool visibly works, tightening or slimming the face and jawline with regular use.
Reviewers praise the shape and feel, noting it fits the hand and facial curves and glides smoothly.
Some reviewers report skin benefits like reduced dark circles, clearer or glowing skin, and better absorption of serums and moisturizers.
A few reviewers complain the tool is thin and fragile, with one breaking right out of the package.
Some reviewers question the material, saying it is man-made or not a real facial scraper.
